## `mainframe.storage.group.capacity`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `mainframe.storage.group.capacity` | UpDownCounter | `By` | Total provisioned storage capacity of the DPM storage group. [1] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `mainframe.storage.group` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[1]:** No IBM Z HMC Web Services API source is currently known: SC27-2646-01 defines no storage-group capacity property, and the zhmc-prometheus-exporter `storagegroup-resource` group exposes only `type`, `fulfillment-state`, `shared` and `max-partitions`. Derive it by summing the `size` property of the group's storage volumes. This is the sum of the sizes of all backing storage volumes in the group, analogous to the total capacity of a Kubernetes StorageClass or cloud storage pool.

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`mainframe.storage.group.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The name of the DPM storage group attached to the Central Processing Complex (CPC). [1] | `sg-fcp-prod`; `sg-nvme-test` |
| [`mainframe.storage.group.type`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-type) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The connectivity type of the DPM storage group. [2] | `fcp`; `fc`; `nvme` |
| [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [3] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |

**[1] `mainframe.storage.group.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group resource object field `name` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). A storage group aggregates storage volumes of the same connectivity type (FCP, FC, NVMe) that are managed together and can be attached to partitions.

**[2] `mainframe.storage.group.type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group object field `type` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1).

**[3] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) that owns the storage group.

---

`mainframe.storage.group.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fc` | FC (native Fibre Channel / ECKD) storage group — IBM ECKD disk format. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `fcp` | FCP (Fibre Channel Protocol) storage group — SCSI over Fibre Channel. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `nvme` | NVMe storage group — NVMe over Fabrics. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

## `mainframe.storage.group.volume.capacity`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `mainframe.storage.group.volume.capacity` | UpDownCounter | `By` | Size of the DPM storage volume. [3] | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `mainframe.storage.group.volume` |

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**[3]:** Reported by the IBM Z HMC Web Services API storage-volume object property `size` (DPM mode only, HMC >= 2.14.1) as a floating-point number of GiB; collectors multiply it by 1073741824 and round to whole bytes. ECKD alias volumes report 0. When `size` is null, no data point is recorded. Represents the raw provisioned capacity of a single backing SAN volume (LUN, ECKD DASD cylinder set, or NVMe namespace), analogous to the capacity of a Kubernetes Persistent Volume or a cloud block storage volume.

[7] | `sg-fcp-prod`; `sg-nvme-test` |
| [`mainframe.storage.group.volume.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-volume-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The name of the DPM storage volume within a storage group. [8] | `vol-boot-0`; `vol-data-1` |
| [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. | [`mainframe.storage.fulfillment.state`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-fulfillment-state) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The fulfillment state of the DPM storage group or storage volume. [10] | `complete`; `pending`; `pending-with-mismatches` |

**[7] `mainframe.storage.group.name`:** The name of the storage group that contains this volume.

**[8] `mainframe.storage.group.volume.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-volume resource object field `name` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). A storage volume is a single logical unit of block storage (LUN / ECKD DASD cylinder set / NVMe namespace) within a storage group.

**[9] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) that owns the storage group.

**[10] `mainframe.storage.fulfillment.state`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group or storage-volume object field `fulfillment-state` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to the binding phase of a Kubernetes Persistent Volume Claim.

---

`mainframe.storage.fulfillment.state` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checking-migration` | The storage resource is being checked for migration eligibility. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `complete` | The storage resource is fully configured and available. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `configuration-error` | The storage volume has a configuration error. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `deleting` | The storage volume is being deleted. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `incomplete` | The storage resource is incompletely configured and not fully available. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `overprovisioned` | The storage volume is overprovisioned. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `pending` | The storage resource is pending configuration by the storage administrator. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `pending-with-mismatches` | The storage resource is pending but has configuration mismatches that must be resolved. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
